summary: This clinical trial tested a drug called SAL003 in adults with high levels of fats in their blood, known as hypercholesterolemia and mixed dyslipidemia. The study compared the effects of SAL003 against a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks just like the medicine. Researchers looked at how the drug affected Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol, which is often called bad cholesterol. The status of this trial is Completed.
